title: De-flake largetimeline.test.ts wall-clock perf assertion
description: De-flaked largetimeline.test.ts. Replaced brittle absolute wall-clock assertions (notably getKeyframeAt < 5ms, which intermittently measured 10.3ms under parallel load) with a warmup + median-of-N timing helper (medianTimeMs) and generous 50ms ceilings. All three perf-guard tests (getAllKeyframes, getKeyframeAt, copyFrames on ~10k-frame layers) now use it. Ceilings still catch a real O(n^2) regression (which would cost hundreds of ms to seconds on ~10k frames) but no longer fail on scheduler noise. TEST-ONLY change; no production code touched. Verified: full ordered build exit 0; @flash/core 5700 passed/8 skipped; largetimeline test green 5x standalone and 3x under heavy CPU load.
